political-purpose attribution remains unresolved.","The Alvarez material now supports direct attribution for cabinet-retention decisions and preserves contrary evidence about de la Rúa's stated desire to keep the coalition together, but repeated reports remain duplicate coverage of one event and should not be counted independently.","The CPJ and IPI material distinguishes national conduct from provincial or local intimidation; subordinate conduct must not be attributed directly to de la Rúa without additional direction, knowledge, tolerance, benefit, obstruction, correction, or authority evidence.","The government-advertising item remains term-wide and cannot support a calendar-2000 claim without year isolation.","The DNU count and several academic claims still depend on snippet or gateway surfaces with incomplete underlying source chains.","Absence of evidence remains improperly usable only as a research gap in the personality-cult, digital-control, and re-election themes; it cannot support favorable restraint findings.","The handoff still contains prohibited researcher-written score-range and anchor advice in its concluding summary; this must be removed before judging.","Local V-Dem and WGI facts remain contextual priors and cannot establish ruler merit or ruler-attributed conduct." ]}],"global_findings":["The supervisor round materially improved defensibility through located legal, press, NGO, and human-rights-report units, but the dossier still has recoverable attribution, year-isolation, contrary-evidence, and coverage gaps.","The source-family count should exclude duplicate surfaces and repeated Alvarez reporting; the estimate reflects distinct publisher/origin families rather than URL count.","The current defensible estimate excludes snippet-only, gateway-only, duplicated, inherited-baseline, and misattributed items; bundled located items still require deterministic splitting before final handoff.","Continuation remains warranted because additional locator recovery and targeted searches could materially improve the dossier; no credible saturation or access-blocker explanation establishes that further research would be unproductive.","No researcher score, score range, anchor, ranking recommendation, or judge advice should be retained in the handoff."],"needs_continuation":true,"reviewer_summary":"Chapter 4B requires continuation.
